scenes.say: Ever wonder how Go keeps your code tidy and handles dependencies? Let’s break it down.

scenes.label: Package
scenes.sub: A package is a collection of Go files. It’s how Go groups related code.
scenes.say: Packages are just collections of Go files, grouped together so your code stays organized.

scenes.title: Go modules in action
scenes.say: Modules manage dependencies and versions. The module file tracks everything your project needs.
Packages group code. Modules handle dependencies and versions. Both are core to modern Go.

scenes.question: What does go.mod do?
scenes.right: It declares your module path and lists dependencies for reproducible builds.
scenes.say: Don’t confuse go.mod with packages. It’s all about tracking dependencies and module info.
